desc: Derive and validate deterministic bottom-up remainder propagation, including local path-degree and exact-length constraints.
Check edge cases: K=1, N=1, star-shaped trees, and paths whose total size is divisible by K.
Design an iterative DFS/postorder implementation safe for NK up to 2×10^5.
Produce Python code that reads stdin, applies the validation algorithm, and prints `Yes` or `No`.
